## Motivation

Split out from the Ling-3.1-flash day-0 support effort.

Three correctness fixes on the serving/parser path, all validated on public models:

1. **Implicit end of thinking drops tool-call constraints.** When a model's reasoning ends not with an explicit think-end token but directly with a tool-call marker, the inner grammar was never engaged, so tool arguments after the marker were unconstrained free text. On Qwen3-30B-Thinking with a schema forcing `priority ∈ {1,2,3}` and `</think>` suppressed, base produces a schema-invalid call 9/10 times; with this PR 10/10 are schema-valid, and logprobs show the grammar's begin-sequence taking over right after the marker token.
2. **Nullable string arguments are stringified.** The GLM-4.5 detector converts a bare `null` argument into the strings `"None"` (non-streaming) or `'null'` (streaming), violating schemas that declare `type: ["string", "null"]`, `anyOf`, or `nullable: true`.
3. **Pathological regex backtracking on unclosed tool calls.** A tail of N repeated `<tool_call>` openers costs quadratic time in the GLM detector's split/stream/detail regexes — measured server-side at 13.1 s for N=16000, executed inside the HTTP event loop. This PR makes the scan linear (0.007 s at N=16000) with identical outputs on 4,000 generated inputs.

## Modifications

- `ReasonerGrammarObject` probes a complete tool-start marker during thinking via a new atomic `try_accept_tokens` on the grammar backends (XGrammar, llguidance, Outlines), replays it into the inner grammar, and rolls the replay back across the boundary on rollback. Only complete, non-line-anchored markers accepted by the inner grammar trigger the transition; answer-framed dispatch and request-specific terminators (#44716) are preserved.
- The GLM-4.5 detector resolves local `$ref` against the containing parameters schema and decides null-permission with three-valued composition logic; whenever the full constraint cannot be established (root-level composition/`enum`/`const`, nested `$id` resources, unresolvable references), it conservatively keeps the previous string behavior. Validated against `jsonschema.Draft202012Validator` on 2×20,000 generated schemas with zero false-null emissions.
- The GLM regexes stop retrying every opener in an unclosed tail.

## Accuracy Tests

- GB300 4x, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, full GSM8K (1319 questions, temp 1.0, top_p 0.95): PR **96.29%** vs base 96.51% (single-run sampling noise); **stop rate 100% both**, zero request errors.
- API regression (streaming + non-streaming): `tool_choice=required` and named tools produce schema-valid JSON arguments (52/54 identical to base; the 2 mismatches are the pre-existing named-tool legacy structural-tag behavior, identical on base). Nullable `["string","null"]` argument yields JSON `null` 12/12 on the Qwen detector (unchanged) and on the GLM-4.5 detector (was `"None"`). Plain requests: 6/6 normal `stop`.
- CPU: 797 passed in `test/registered/unit/{constrained,function_call}` with pinned XGrammar 0.2.7; the two new null-preservation regressions fail on base and pass here; composed-schema and ordinary-string probes show no output change outside the intended nullable cases.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not a performance PR. The regex fix removes a quadratic worst case (13.1 s → 0.007 s at N=16000 repeated openers); ordinary tool-call parsing cost is unchanged.

Co-authored-by: 文贤 <luoyuan.luo@antgroup.com>
Co-authored-by: 得泽 <zhangkaihong.zkh@antgroup.com>

+# Root keywords that can constrain a property beyond its own `properties` entry.
+_ROOT_PROPERTY_CONSTRAINTS = (
+    "enum",
+    "const",
+    "allOf",
+    "anyOf",
+    "oneOf",
+    "not",
+    "if",
+    "$ref",
+    "$dynamicRef",
+    "$recursiveRef",
+    "patternProperties",
+    "dependentSchemas",
+    "dependencies",

+def _argument_allows_null(
+    func_name: str, arg_key: str, defined_tools: List[Tool]
+) -> bool:
+    name2tool = {tool.function.name: tool for tool in defined_tools}
+    if func_name not in name2tool:
+        return False
+    parameters = name2tool[func_name].function.parameters
+    if not isinstance(parameters, dict) or any(
+        keyword in parameters for keyword in _ROOT_PROPERTY_CONSTRAINTS
+    ):
+        return False
+    properties = parameters.get("properties")
+    if not isinstance(properties, dict) or arg_key not in properties:
+        return False
+    return _null_validity(properties[arg_key], parameters, frozenset()) is True
+
+
+def _resolve_local_ref(ref: Any, root: Any) -> Any:
+    if not isinstance(ref, str) or not (ref == "#" or ref.startswith("#/")):
+        return None
+    target = root
+    try:
+        for part in ref[2:].split("/") if ref != "#" else []:
+            # A pointer that crosses an embedded `$id` resource is not resolved here.
+            if target is not root and isinstance(target, dict) and "$id" in target:
+                return None
+            part = part.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
+            target = target[int(part)] if isinstance(target, list) else target[part]
+    except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError):
+        return None
+    return target
+
+
+def _all_valid(results: List[Optional[bool]]) -> Optional[bool]:
+    if False in results:
+        return False
+    return None if None in results else True
+
+
+def _any_valid(results: List[Optional[bool]]) -> Optional[bool]:
+    if True in results:
+        return True
+    return None if None in results else False
+
+
+def _null_validity(
+    schema: Any, root: Any, seen: frozenset[int], in_embedded_resource: bool = False
+) -> Optional[bool]:
+    """None when an unresolvable reference or a cycle leaves it undecided;
+    three-valued so ``not`` cannot turn an unknown into an allowed null."""
+    if isinstance(schema, bool):
+        return schema
+    if not isinstance(schema, dict) or id(schema) in seen:
+        return None
+    seen = seen | {id(schema)}
+    # Below an embedded `$id`, `#/...` refers to that resource, not to `root`.
+    in_embedded_resource = in_embedded_resource or (
+        "$id" in schema and schema is not root
+    )
+
+    def validity(branch: Any) -> Optional[bool]:
+        return _null_validity(branch, root, seen, in_embedded_resource)
+
+    results: List[Optional[bool]] = []
+    if "type" in schema:
+        schema_type = schema["type"]
+        results.append(
+            schema_type == "null"
+            or (isinstance(schema_type, list) and "null" in schema_type)
+            or schema.get("nullable") is True
+        )
+    if isinstance(schema.get("enum"), list):
+        results.append(None in schema["enum"])
+    if "const" in schema:
+        results.append(schema["const"] is None)
+    if "$ref" in schema:
+        results.append(
+            None
+            if in_embedded_resource
+            else validity(_resolve_local_ref(schema["$ref"], root))
+        )
+    if "$dynamicRef" in schema or "$recursiveRef" in schema:
+        results.append(None)
+    if isinstance(schema.get("anyOf"), list):
+        results.append(_any_valid([validity(branch) for branch in schema["anyOf"]]))
+    if isinstance(schema.get("oneOf"), list):
+        branches = [validity(branch) for branch in schema["oneOf"]]
+        matches = branches.count(True)
+        results.append(
+            False if matches > 1 else None if None in branches else matches == 1
+        )
+    if isinstance(schema.get("allOf"), list):
+        results.append(_all_valid([validity(branch) for branch in schema["allOf"]]))
+    if "not" in schema:
+        negated = validity(schema["not"])
+        results.append(None if negated is None else not negated)
+    if "if" in schema:
+        condition = validity(schema["if"])
+        then_valid = validity(schema.get("then", True))

+
+                tool_calls = self._collect_streaming_tool_calls(list(text))
+
+                params = json.loads(tool_calls[0]["parameters"])
+                self.assertEqual(params, {"body": value})
+                self.assertIsInstance(params["body"], str)
+
+    def _parse_raw_null_argument(self, parameters):
+        """`x` from a raw `null` value: the non-streaming result, and the distinct
+        streamed results over whole-chunk, per-character and every single cut."""
+        text = (
+            "<tool_call>f\n"
+            "<arg_key>x</arg_key>\n<arg_value>null</arg_value>\n"
+            "</tool_call>"
+        )
+        self.tools = [
+            Tool(type="function", function=Function(name="f", parameters=parameters))
+        ]
+        result = Glm4MoeDetector().detect_and_parse(text, self.tools)
+        non_streaming = json.loads(result.calls[0].parameters)["x"]
+        plans = [[text], list(text)]
+        plans += [[text[:cut], text[cut:]] for cut in range(1, len(text))]
+        streamed = set()
+        for chunks in plans:
+            self.detector = Glm4MoeDetector()
+            tool_calls = self._collect_streaming_tool_calls(chunks)
+            streamed.add(json.loads(tool_calls[0]["parameters"])["x"])
+        return non_streaming, streamed
+
+    def test_nullable_check_follows_refs(self):
+        """A `$ref` branch makes an argument nullable only if its target allows null;
+        `anyOf: [string, $ref -> integer]` must keep a raw `null` as a string."""
+        for count_schema, expected in (
+            ({"type": "integer"}, ("None", {"null"})),
+            ({"type": "null"}, (None, {None})),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(count=count_schema):
+                parameters = {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {
+                        "x": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/count"}]}
+                    },
+                    "$defs": {"count": count_schema},
+                    "required": ["x"],
+                }
+                self.assertEqual(self._parse_raw_null_argument(parameters), expected)
+
+    def test_nullable_check_keeps_string_when_null_is_not_established(self):
+        """Null that one schema branch allows but the full parameters schema rejects
+        must not be emitted; the raw `null` keeps its string form."""
+        cases = {
+            "root allOf narrows x to string": {
+                "type": "object",
+                "allOf": [
+                    {"properties": {"x": {"type": ["string", "null"]}}},
+                    {"properties": {"x": {"type": "string"}}},
+                ],
+                "required": ["x"],
+            },
+            "ref resolves inside an embedded $id resource": {
+                "type": "object",
+                "properties": {
+                    "x": {
+                        "anyOf": [
+                            {"type": "string"},
+                            {
+                                "$id": "https://example.com/integer-branch",
+                                "$defs": {"count": {"type": "integer"}},
+                                "$ref": "#/$defs/count",
+                            },
+                        ]
+                    }
+                },
+                "$defs": {"count": {"type": "null"}},
+                "required": ["x"],
+            },
+            "root enum": {
+                "type": "object",
+                "properties": {"x": {"type": ["string", "null"]}},
+                "required": ["x"],
+                "enum": [{"x": "null"}, {"x": "None"}],
+            },
+            "root const": {
+                "type": "object",
+                "properties": {"x": {"type": ["string", "null"]}},
+                "required": ["x"],
+                "const": {"x": "null"},
+            },
+        }
+        for name, parameters in cases.items():
+            with self.subTest(name):
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    self._parse_raw_null_argument(parameters), ("None", {"null"})
+                )
+
